event: After the NY Monday range locks, locate the first strict breach per weekly rail, counting earlier wicks as breaches. An exact touch does not consume the rail.
shape: Use the closed 1H, then enclosing UTC 4H, then enclosing UTC 12H of that same first breach. For a short, require a high above the upper rail, an open at or below it and a close strictly back inside the two rails. Mirror for a long. Only fully eligible source candles are used.
trend: Retain the original developing 12H EMA20/50 direction at the chosen close. The primary ladder only advances when the smaller candle did not provide a qualifying wick shape. Keep first eligible signal per NY week.
scope: Historical signal identification only. No new fill, payout or account results. This rule differs from the previously simulated cumulative 12H excursion followed by a later hourly reclaim.
